nodes.description: Public uint64 storing the timestamp at which the next jackpot becomes available.
Public bool flag that pauses jackpot activity when set to true.
Public address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender on deployment.
Public uint used as the percentage/payout factor for the jackpot prize.
Public uint configuring the winner limit.
Public uint tracking the current jackpot period index, incremented each draw.
Public address of the authorised dice roll contract allowed to add players.
Private uint256 pseudo-random seed mutated by the rand() function.
Public mapping from period number to the winning address.
Public dynamic array holding the addresses eligible for the current draw.
Constructor that assigns msg.sender as the contract owner.
Payable fallback function that accepts plain ether transfers.
External view function returning the winner address for a given period.
Public function restricted to the dice roll address that appends a player to tempPlayer.
Owner-only function that picks a pseudo-random winner, records it and pays out the jackpot.
Internal function that transfers the computed jackpot amount to the winner.
Owner-only setter that updates the jackpotPersent state variable.
Internal function generating a pseudo-random uint from block attributes and the stored seed.
Owner-only function that toggles the jackpotPaused flag.
Owner-only setter that updates the diceRollAddress state variable.
Owner-only function that transfers an arbitrary amount of ether to an arbitrary address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership setup and modifier access checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute nextJackpotTime.
External transfer of ether to the winner address inside sendJackpot.
External transfer of ether to a caller-supplied address inside ownerTransferEther.
Parameter 'add' of addPlayer: address of the player appended to tempPlayer.
Parameter 'periods' of getWinnerHistory: index used to look up winnerHistory.
Local variable 'random' in createWinner, derived from rand() modulo tempPlayer.length.
Local variable 'winner' in createWinner, the drawn address passed to sendJackpot.
Local variable 'tmNow' in createWinner holding uint64(block.timestamp).
Parameter 'winner' of sendJackpot: recipient of the jackpot payout.
Parameter 'amount' of sendJackpot: ether amount transferred to the winner.
Parameter 'newPersent' of seTJackpotPersent: new value for jackpotPersent.
Parameter 'newStatus' of ownerPauseJackpot: new value for jackpotPaused.
Parameter 'add' of ownerSetdiceRollAddress: new value for diceRollAddress.
Parameter 'sendTo' of ownerTransferEther: destination of the ether transfer.
Parameter 'amount' of ownerTransferEther: ether amount transferred to sendTo.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor.
Constructor writes the untrusted caller address into the owner state variable.
addPlayer is guarded by onlyDiceRoll which compares msg.sender to diceRollAddress.
addPlayer reads diceRollAddress to validate the caller in the onlyDiceRoll modifier.
addPlayer pushes the supplied address into the tempPlayer array.
addPlayer is guarded by jackpotAreActive which reads jackpotPaused.
Parameter 'add' flows into the tempPlayer push operation of addPlayer.
createWinner is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
createWinner calls rand() to obtain a pseudo-random number.
createWinner derives nextJackpotTime from the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
createWinner multiplies the contract balance by jackpotPersent without overflow protection.
createWinner reads and clears tempPlayer while selecting the winner.
createWinner writes the selected winner into winnerHistory for the current period.
createWinner indexes winnerHistory and increments JackpotPeriods, an unchecked counter.
createWinner invokes sendJackpot to pay out the prize.
createWinner is guarded by jackpotAreActive which reads jackpotPaused.
createWinner stores the rand() modulo result in the local variable random.
createWinner indexes tempPlayer with random to produce the local variable winner.
createWinner casts block.timestamp into the local variable tmNow.
The winner local variable is passed as the recipient argument to sendJackpot.
sendJackpot performs an external ether transfer to the winner address.
The winner.transfer call can re-enter the calling contract before final state updates complete.
Parameter 'winner' of sendJackpot is the recipient used in the payout.
Parameter 'amount' of sendJackpot is the value forwarded in the transfer call.
rand() overwrites the seed state variable with a value derived from block attributes.
getWinnerHistory reads from the winnerHistory mapping.
Parameter 'periods' is used as the key when reading winnerHistory in getWinnerHistory.
seTJackpotPersent is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
seTJackpotPersent writes the validated value into the jackpotPersent state variable.
Parameter 'newPersent' flows into the jackpotPersent assignment of seTJackpotPersent.
ownerPauseJackpot is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
ownerPauseJackpot writes the new status into the jackpotPaused state variable.
Parameter 'newStatus' flows into the jackpotPaused assignment of ownerPauseJackpot.
ownerSetdiceRollAddress is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
ownerSetdiceRollAddress writes the supplied address into the diceRollAddress state variable.
Parameter 'add' flows into the diceRollAddress assignment of ownerSetdiceRollAddress.
ownerTransferEther is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
ownerTransferEther performs an external ether transfer to a caller-supplied address.
The sendTo.transfer call can re-enter the contract before the state is finalised.
Parameter 'sendTo' is the destination of the ownerTransferEther transfer call.
Parameter 'amount' is the value forwarded in the ownerTransferEther transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: The address parameter only flows into the tempPlayer push performed by addPlayer.
The periods parameter is only used as the lookup key inside getWinnerHistory.
The random local is a short-lived intermediate of createWinner's selection logic.
The winner local is the direct output of createWinner's draw logic.
tmNow is only a casted copy of block.timestamp inside createWinner.
The winner parameter only feeds the payout performed by sendJackpot.
The amount parameter is consumed directly by the winner.transfer value transfer.
The newPersent parameter is only assigned to jackpotPersent inside the setter.
The newStatus parameter is only assigned to jackpotPaused inside the setter.
The add parameter is only assigned to diceRollAddress inside the setter.
The sendTo parameter is the recipient consumed by the external transfer operation.
The amount parameter is the value consumed by the external transfer operation.
